summary: Assemble scattered pixels and sprites into a complete composite image by matching edges without rotation.
src: scattered non-background pixels and sprite fragments s
match_cond: s.edge.position aligns with d.adjacent_piece.edge to form continuous rectangular shape
multi_step: Step 1: identify all non-background colored fragments; Step 2: assemble fragments by matching their edges to form complete jigsaw-like composition; Step 3: output tight crop of assembled result
notes: output has exact left-right mirror symmetry; same-color pieces must not 4-touch each other
